0f5101aa82ed33461d94.text: In the previous part of the module, you have read the poem entitled “Context Clues.” What are some of the words that you find difficult to understand? How do you unlock the meaning of the words? What are the clues that help you solve them?

0a8187f378bbc5c9bbb3.text: 1. As a writer, Dr. Jose Rizal used several pseudonyms so as not to reveal his

9bc8ec5370a703aa34cb.text:
real identity.
2. We should always be prudent in what we say so as not to hurt the feelings of others.

c6ddd7d2cdfae11fd0fc.text: Look at sentence number 1, what do you think is the meaning of the word pseudonyms? The answer is pen names.

dda3635bc1c55a5e1525.text: How about in sentence number 2, what do you think is the meaning of the word prudent? The answer is careful.

db4941645efb602e4e5e.text: How did you know the answers? What words helped you identify the meanings of those unfamiliar words?

c329997ef4791a3226c7.text: The words not to reveal helped you identify the meaning of pseudonyms in sentence number 1 while the words not to hurt helped you identify the meaning of prudent in sentence number 2.

f0fd3d057a8b3821e056.text: One of the ways in determining meaning of words and expressions reflecting local culture is through context clues. These words served as the clues in the sentences.

dc9ea0766c286a5c8d00.text: Context clues are words that appear in sentences to help understand the meanings of difficult words. Context clues are of different types:

bed773eb2b8ac5e68bd2.text:
•
the unfamiliar word is defined in a sentence
Example:

2115f700ccb4c9205b8b.text:
An Archeologist is a person who searches for treasures from sunken ships and
ancient tombs to obtain valuable relics, artifacts, and relics such as the Balanghai
boat.
(definition: a person who searches for treasures, artifacts, and relics)
2. by Synonym

4a8820886bc911a4a677.text:
•
a similar word is placed in the same sentence to know the meaning of the
unfamiliar word
Example:

f8214e255820cf6a9c8c.text:
It is common for Filipinos to feel compassion or pity for the suffering of their
fellowmen.
(synonym: pity)
3. by Antonym

5620e5d591d0b695ab7d.text:
•
an opposite word is placed in the same sentence
Example:

c3d6d0f8b554d1c680cb.text:
Among the siblings of thin body structure, Isabel is the only one who is portly.
(antonym: thin)
4. by Comparison

92ff92c657e9d2ba9383.text:
•
a similar word with the same meaning of the unfamiliar word is placed with an
object to be compared
Example:

70ba60df87d5712a583e.text:
The stench of the garbage was like the smell of a rotten fish.
(comparison: rotten fish, means bad odor)
5. by Example

3971cf04eed7ec67144c.text:
•
samples are provided in the sentence to understand the meaning of the unfamiliar
word
Example:

4e36b687ad6df467663f.text: In ancient times, some of our forefathers believed in amulets, such as pearl of the crocodile, pearl of the ax, bullet necklace, and bag of herbs to protect them from harm.

3a35cbe1df2b294626f1.text: (example: pearl of the crocodile, pearl of the ax, bullet necklace, bag of herbs)

61198e542936906cf493.text:
•
a description is given to understand the meaning of the unfamiliar word
Example:

6c5e011dc9559947e043.text:
Matthew had few infractions of the house rules that he should have done as part
of his responsibilities.
(explanation: house rules that he should have done)
7. by Cause-Effect

00b31369abcda841e373.text:
•
the meaning of the difficult word depends on the cause-effect relationship of other
words as expressed in the sentence
Example:

39722b1c5a27a1345cab.text:
Since only a few followed the wearing of face mask, it was made mandatory by the
government.
(cause: only a few followed the wearing of face mask)
8. by List or Series of clues

cbc843d6ddb14af774e4.text:
•
to understand the meaning of the unknown word, it is included in a series of words
given in a sentence
Example:

9e64798869504144af86.text:
After the program, the rubbish left such as souvenir programs, flyers, leaflets
plastic bottles, and food wrappings were cleaned by the janitor.
(list: souvenir programs, flyers, leaflets, plastic bottles, food wrappings)
9. by Inference

7842f253f653131d75bf.text:
•
to understand the meaning of the unknown word, one has to make a guess based
on the description given in the sentence
Example:

f3c953ca5ec017ed5102.text: When one shows hospitality, kind words and welcoming actions can be observed among Filipinos. (description: kind words, welcoming actions)
